desc: Ideation: model as two-layer state graph (vertex, parity), Dijkstra with implicit adjacency via out/in lists, 64-bit distances.
Implement input parsing and build `out_adj` (original direction) and `in_adj` (reversed direction) with consistent 1-based indexing.
Implement Dijkstra over states `(v, p)` with `dist0`/`dist1`, min-heap, stale-entry skipping; relax moves (cost 1, parity-appropriate neighbor list) and flips (cost X, same vertex, flipped parity).

Output `min(dist0[N], dist1[N])` as a Python integer; logic matches samples (4, 3, 4294967299, 21) and handles edge cases (X=1, large answers via Python ints, self-loops/parallel edges harmless to Dijkstra).
